name: relative-snet
why: Constraints apply on a relative program (plan 6.1, 13.1, 13.3 Q2). Its constraint dates are read from RelativeEpoch 2001-01-01, a Monday: index 0 = Mon 1 Jan 2001 = Week 1, day 1, Mon-Fri working, and the holiday row on Wed 10 Jan is ignored because a relative program has no holidays. No dates are returned.

a.why: Week 1, days 1-5. LF = LS_b 9 - 0 = 9, LS = 9 - 5 = 4, TF 4. FF = ES_b 7 - link result 5 = 2.

b.why: SNET Wed 10 Jan 2001 = Week 2, day 3 = index 7 (the holiday on that day is ignored, so it is still a working day). The link allows 5, so ES = max(5, 7) = 7 and ab is not driving. LF = PF 12.

c.why: MSO Sat 13 Jan 2001 lands on the first working day on or after it, Mon 15 Jan = Week 3, day 1 = index 10. EF 12 = PF.
